basis.M10W29: No preregistered low-ATR microstructure family advanced; post-result tuning is forbidden.
basis.M10W30: Post-result diagnostic found material 2026 scale drift in M5/M1 range and bps spread/return representations while frozen formula trigger densities remained broadly stable.
basis.interpretation_limit: M10W30 does not rescue M10W29. M10W31 audits information availability and stability only.

exact_parent_cohort.source: M10W27 7480-row low-ATR bullish prefix-causal NEITHER feature file
exact_parent_cohort.target: D1 EMA20>EMA30>EMA40 AND H4 EMA20>EMA30 AND H1 MACD line>0 AND H1 ATR percentile100<0.33 AND prefix-causal coverage=NEITHER

required_outputs: availability/missingness and unique-value/variance checks by train/validation/test/all
PSI and descriptive KS for validation/test versus train
audit proving no return, PF, PnL, win/loss label, trade ledger or future path was read

decision_rules.next: Only after reviewing availability and cross-split stability may at most three simple scale-normalized families be preregistered. Any historical evaluation is exploratory because M10W29 outcomes and M10W30 diagnosis are already known, and independent fresh prospective support remains mandatory.
